{{Quote|On the MilNet. A kill-or-capture order has been issued for an ex-Imperial scientist called Tag Rogaren|Ensign Nanda|<ref name="SW14">[[Star Wars (2013) 14|''Star Wars'' (2013) 14]]</ref>}}
The '''Imperial MilNet''' was the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide communications network of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. It could be accessed with [[Comm unit/Legends|personal communications]] gear by active-duty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|troopers]], off-duty troops, recruits, trainees, local [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]], [[Transport/Legends|transport]] guards, and professional [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. One of the functions of the MilNet was to transmit open Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|contracts]] for kill/capture orders. [[Standard month/Legends|Months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], one such order was issued against the ex-Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Tag Rogaren]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Elite stormtrooper (Galactic Empire)|Elite stormtroopers]] intercepted this order and claimed it superseded Vader's off-the-books [[Mission to Alderaan (Darth Vader)|mission]].<ref name="SW14" />
